attributes.name: Druva - Audit Activity Outside Business Hours
attributes.description: Detects audit activity outside business hours in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects audit activity outside business hours in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Admin Audit Trail" AND (DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp) < 7 OR DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp) >= 19)
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
